name: Frog
label: Jumping frog
review: Reference-based fold sequence; shaping angles are illustrative.
descriptions: Fold the square in half from right to left.
Bring the upper left corner across the top square.
Bring the upper right corner across the top square.
Fold the top edge backward through the diagonal intersection.
Close the upper square along its creases while the lower rectangle stays extended.
Lift the front right triangle to the top point.
Bring the right body edge to the middle, leaving the front legs free.
Bring the left body edge to the middle.
Raise the lower section toward the front legs.
Fold half of the raised section back down.
Turn the entire model over without adding a crease. Keep all the layers together.
Fold the tip of the front foot outward.
Fold the other front foot outward.
Ease the spring pleat open slightly for the resting shape.
